limitations.title: Residual classification errors
limitations.impact: Incorrect verdicts remain possible in real-world usage.
limitations.evidence: Observed error rate is 0.625 (62.5 errors per 100 claims).
limitations.mitigation: Route low-confidence outputs to human review; expand evaluation set and tune calibration.

limitations.title: Category-specific generalization gaps
limitations.impact: Performance is uneven across claim domains.
limitations.evidence: Categories below threshold 0.60: general=0.00 (n=2); technology=0.00 (n=6); health=0.00 (n=3); conflict=0.00 (n=3); science=0.14 (n=7); demographics=0.25 (n=4); politics=0.25 (n=4); work=0.50 (n=4)
limitations.mitigation: Increase domain-balanced benchmark size and add domain-specific retrieval prompts/models.

limitations.title: Debate arbitration can introduce regressions
limitations.impact: Debate mode may change verdicts without guaranteed net improvement.
limitations.evidence: Debate changed 0/7 cases (0.00); regressions observed in 0/7 (0.00).
limitations.mitigation: Trigger debate selectively (only uncertain baseline cases) and validate with guardrail thresholds.

limitations.title: Confidence calibration mismatch
limitations.impact: Displayed confidence may overstate or understate true correctness.
limitations.evidence: Calibration error=0.174, ECE=0.223 in current split.
limitations.mitigation: Apply post-hoc calibration (temperature scaling / isotonic regression) on larger validation data.

limitations.title: Source-selection and credibility-rubric bias
limitations.impact: System trust signals may favor mainstream indexed domains and under-represent local/novel sources.
limitations.evidence: Credibility scoring relies on domain rubric and search-retrieved evidence, not exhaustive ground truth.
limitations.mitigation: Introduce external expert calibration panel and diversify retrieval sources beyond a single search index.

limitations.title: Limited statistical power from small evaluation split
limitations.impact: Point estimates and p-values are sensitive to a few cases.
limitations.mitigation: Expand benchmark to 100+ claims per major domain and recompute all comparison statistics.
